old_full_disposition.title: The path conjecture for maximum von Neumann entropy of trees

old_full_disposition.title: Recursive width conjecture for torus knots
old_full_disposition.literal_statement:
Let $T_{p,q}$ denote the torus knot associated to positive coprime integers $p$ and $q$, and let $\widehat{HFK}(T_{p,q})$ be its knot Floer homology. Write $\operatorname{width}\widehat{HFK}(T_{p,q})$ for its width. **Recursive width conjecture.** If $p<q$, then

$$
\operatorname{width}\widehat{HFK}(T_{p,q})-\operatorname{width}\widehat{HFK}(T_{p,q-p})=\left\lfloor\frac{(p-1)^2}{4}\right\rfloor.

Together with the base case $\operatorname{width}\widehat{HFK}(T_{1,q})=1$ and the symmetry $T_{p,q}=T_{q,p}$, this would recursively determine the width for every torus knot.
